project_name: Premium Personal Portfolio - Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist

theme_details.overall_vibe: Professional, Clean, Premium, Modern, Enterprise-ready, Trustworthy, Performance-focused. Apple/Stripe/Linear aesthetics.

colors.hero_gradient: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FAFAFA] via-[#F3F4F6] to-[#EFF6FF] (subtle premium blue tint)

rules.strict_rule: NEVER mix fonts. ONLY use Inter. Achieve premium feel through extreme weight contrast and spacing.
rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#111827] leading-[1.1]
rules.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#111827] leading-tight

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing. Card paddings should be p-8 or p-10.
layouts.grid_system: Bento-style grids for Expertise and Why Hire Me. Assymetrical layouts where possible (e.g., 7-col / 5-col split for About section).

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 on load using Framer Motion.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion viewport triggers. Fade up and slight scale (0.98 to 1) for cards as they enter the viewport.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on background geometric images or 3D floating effect on hero elements.
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (kinetic text ribbon) for the 'Marketing Stack' section or a 'Trusted By / Expertise' repeating line.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.features: Sticky nav with smooth scroll to sections. Active section highlight. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70. Includes Logo (Smit Patel), Links, and a 'Contact' button.

sections.name: Hero
sections.features: Subtle premium gradient background. H1 'Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist'. Subheading listing Performance Marketing, SEO, International Marketing, Lead Generation, Analytics, AI-Powered Marketing. Primary CTA 'View Experience' (pill-shaped, blue), Secondary CTA 'Contact Me' (outline), Download Resume CTA (text with icon). Subtle parallax geometric shapes floating in the background.
sections.image_integration: Abstract geometric white background image used with low opacity mix-blend-multiply.

sections.name: About
sections.features: Storytelling layout. Text on left: MS University, Diploma in Computer Eng. Transitioning from technical to marketing. Image on right (professional office desk setup). Numbered manifesto chapters (01. Technical Roots, 02. Data-Driven Creativity).

sections.name: Experience
sections.features: Premium animated vertical timeline. Clean lines (border-[#E5E7EB]). 01: Excellent Jewels (Jul 2024–Jul 2025) - International Markets, Meta Ads. 02: Servall (Aug 2025–Present) - Multi-branch, offline + online. Use subtle hover scale on timeline cards.

sections.name: Expertise
sections.features: Bento grid of animated cards. Categories: Performance Marketing, SEO, AI Search Optimisation, Marketing Automation. Clean typography, icon headers. White cards on #FAFAFA background.

sections.name: Case Studies
sections.features: Two large featured cards: Excellent Jewels and Servall. Image-heavy tops with data analytics screens, factual metrics below. Hover effects trigger slight image zoom.

sections.name: Marketing Stack
sections.features: Slow editorial marquee passing horizontally. Logos/Icons: Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, SEMrush, HubSpot, etc. Monochromatic blue/gray icons for premium feel.

sections.name: Why Hire Me
sections.features: 2x2 crisp grid. Cards: Performance Driven, International Marketing, Technical Foundation, Continuous Learner. 16px rounded, minimal borders, #FFFFFF background.

sections.name: Education
sections.features: Minimalist list view. MS University, Diploma in Computer Engineering. High contrast dates.

sections.name: Contact & Admin
sections.features: Working contact form saving to DB (requires API route / backend setup). Fields: Name, Email, Message. CTA 'Let's build measurable business growth together.' Note: Mention Admin page creation in codebase to view enquiries.

sections.name: Footer
sections.features: Minimal, clean. Copyright text, social links (LinkedIn, Twitter). #FAFAFA background.

components.buttons: Pill shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#2563EB] text-white hover:bg-blue-700 hover:shadow-lg transition-all. Secondary: bg-white text-[#111827] border border-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-gray-50. Include arrow icons on hover.
components.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-[16px] p-8 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300
components.inputs: Shadcn-style minimal inputs. bg-[#FAFAFA] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-[12px] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2563EB]/20 focus:border-[#2563EB]

hero_background.description: Abstract white geometric waves, used as subtle parallax background in Hero.

about_section.description: Modern clean desktop near window, for the About section visual.

case_study_1.description: Data analytics tablet screen, used for the Excellent Jewels International Marketing Case Study.

case_study_2.description: Modern office working environment, for the Servall Growth Marketing Case Study.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use any font other than Inter. Use font-black, font-light, and tight letter spacing to make it look premium.
Create a responsive, bento-style layout. Avoid boring equal columns; use 7-col/5-col splits.
Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-ups and the masked line-by-line hero text reveal.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
The Hero background must use the provided abstract geometric image with a very soft opacity (10-20%) and the `#FAFAFA` to `#EFF6FF` gradient.
All cards must have a 1px border of `#E5E7EB` and rounded-[16px]. No harsh shadows, only the premium soft shadows defined in theme_details.
Build the functional contact form and an Admin page/route to view the saved enquiries.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align text blocks for a more editorial, structured feel.
Use a slow-moving marquee (using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee) for the Marketing Stack section.
